get.description: Get a list of subscription status definitions from the account.

parameters.name: businessUnitId
parameters.description: An integer representing the ID of the business unit for which to retrieve subscription definitions.

parameters.name: includeTranslations
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to include translations of the communication preferences definitions in the response.

post.description: Generate communication preference links for a subscriber. This endpoint allows you to create URLs for managing preferences and unsubscribing, tailored to a specific subscriber. It is useful for integrating communication preference management into your applications.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: The communication channel for which the links are generated. Must be 'EMAIL'.

parameters.name: businessUnitId
parameters.description: The identifier of the business unit. Defaults to 0 if not specified.

post.description: Batch retrieve subscription statuses for a set of contacts.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: The communication channel to filter the subscription statuses. Must be 'EMAIL'.

parameters.name: businessUnitId
parameters.description: An optional integer representing the business unit ID. This parameter helps to filter the results based on the specific business unit.

post.summary: Batch unsubscribe contacts from all subscriptions
post.description: Unsubscribe a set of contacts from all email subscriptions.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: The communication channel from which subscribers will be unsubscribed. This parameter is required and currently supports only 'EMAIL'.

parameters.name: businessUnitId
parameters.description: An optional integer representing the business unit ID for which the operation is being performed.

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to include detailed information in the response. Defaults to false.

post.summary: Batch retrieve contacts who have opted out of all communications
post.description: Checks whether a set of contacts have opted out of all communications.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: The communication channel to filter the unsubscribe statuses. This parameter is required and currently supports 'EMAIL' as a valid value.

parameters.name: businessUnitId
parameters.description: The ID of the business unit to filter the results. This is an optional parameter.

post.description: Update the subscription status for a set of contacts.

get.summary: Get subscription preferences for a specific contact
get.description: Retrieve a contact's current email subscription preferences.

parameters.name: subscriberIdString
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the subscriber whose communication preferences status is being retrieved.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: The communication channel for which the subscription status is being retrieved. This parameter is required and currently supports only 'EMAIL'.

parameters.name: businessUnitId
parameters.description: The ID of the business unit to filter the subscription status by. This is an optional parameter.

post.description: Set the subscription status of a specific contact.

parameters.name: subscriberIdString
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the subscriber whose communication preferences status is being updated.

get.description: Check whether a contact has unsubscribed from all email subscriptions. If a contact has not opted out of all communications, the response `results` array will be empty.

parameters.name: subscriberIdString
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the subscriber to unsubscribe from all communication preferences.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: The communication channel from which to unsubscribe the subscriber. This is a required parameter and must be 'EMAIL'.

parameters.name: businessUnitId
parameters.description: The ID of the business unit to which the subscriber belongs. This is an optional parameter.

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to include detailed information in the response. Defaults to false.
